followup_explanation:
I weighed two things and one didn't end up mattering.

**Capability:** Dunlin scores higher across essentially every relevant metric — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), plus higher Arena-Hard, IFEval, and MMLU-Pro. The Creative Generation gap (~6 points) is well outside the stated run-to-run variance threshold of 2.0, so it's a meaningful difference for a creative-writing request like this one. The user even emphasized quality ("Don't half-ass it"), which reinforces picking the stronger generator.

**Task preferences:** I checked whether either model had a preference that should pull the routing. Both models self-report flat responses only to harm-adjacent/distasteful content — but this query is a wholesome fictional crossover, so that dimension is irrelevant here. Neither model reports a stable preference on ordinary creative tasks, so preferences gave me no reason to deviate from the capability-based choice.

So with capability clearly favoring Dunlin and no preference consideration cutting the other way, Dunlin was the straightforward pick.
